tasks.title: Implement rebase endpoint async conflict resolution
tasks.description: Modify the `POST /:number/rebase` handler in `issues.ts` for async conflict resolution. Add an in-memory `Set<string>` (issueId) for conflict-resolution-in-progress guard. Change `abortOnConflict: true` to `false`. On conflict: return 202 with `{ status: 'resolving-conflicts' }`, emit `rebase_conflict { status: 'resolving' }` and `agent_conflict_resolution_started`, then fire-and-forget an async chain that calls `resolveConflictsViaAgent` → verifies rebase completed → runs stage-specific post-rebase handlers (with `skipBuildVerify` for Review stage) → emits `rebase_progress` + `rebase_completed`. On failure: abort rebase, emit `rebase_conflict { status: 'failed', error }`. Update `rebase_conflict` event type in `event-bus.ts` to include `error?: string`.
acceptanceCriteria: Rebase with conflicts returns 202 `{ success: true, data: { status: 'resolving-conflicts', conflicts: [...] } }` for Plan/Build/Review stages
Rebase without conflicts returns 200 (unchanged behavior)
Done stage rebase still delegates to `mergeQueue.retry()` (unchanged)
In-memory Set prevents duplicate triggers: second rebase request during conflict resolution returns 409 'Conflict resolution in progress'
Set entry is cleared on both success and failure paths
On conflict: SSE emits `rebase_conflict { status: 'resolving' }` then `agent_conflict_resolution_started`
On resolution success: SSE emits `agent_conflict_resolution_completed` then `rebase_progress` then `rebase_completed { rebased: true }`
On resolution failure: SSE emits `agent_conflict_resolution_failed` then `rebase_conflict { status: 'failed', error }` and aborts rebase
Plan stage post-rebase: injects re-evaluate message + resumePipeline
Build stage post-rebase: clears checkpoint
Review stage post-rebase: skips build verify when `skipBuildVerify=true`
Event type `rebase_conflict` in event-bus.ts includes `error?: string` field
Agent is running guard (line 2171) still works and returns 409 before any rebase operations
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The async chain should use `.then()/.catch()` pattern (fire-and-forget). All errors in the chain must be caught — log and emit appropriate events. The `handleReviewRebase` function needs an optional `skipBuildVerify` param that, when true, skips the npm build exec but still emits the verifying progress event for consistency.

tasks.title: Frontend: handle 202 response and SSE conflict resolution progress
tasks.description: Update frontend to handle the new 202 async rebase response and display conflict resolution progress via SSE. In `api.ts`: update `rebaseIssue` return type to include `status?: 'resolving-conflicts'`. In `types.ts`: add `error?: string` to `RebaseConflictState` and to `rebase_conflict` event type. In `IssueDetailPage.tsx`: handle `status === 'resolving-conflicts'` in mutation `onSuccess` to show resolving state. In `useSSE.tsx`: listen for `agent_conflict_resolution_started`/`completed`/`failed` events to track rebase conflict resolution state. In `ReviewApprovalPanel.tsx`, `BranchBar.tsx`, and `WorktreePanel.tsx`: display resolving/failed states based on `rebaseConflict` from `useLiveTask()`, disable rebase button during resolution, and show error messages on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: `api.ts` `rebaseIssue` return type includes `status?: 'resolving-conflicts'`
`types.ts` `RebaseConflictState` has `error?: string` field
`types.ts` `rebase_conflict` event map has `error?: string` field
`IssueDetailPage.tsx` mutation `onSuccess` handles `status === 'resolving-conflicts'` — shows resolving state without treating it as error

`useSSE.tsx` registers listeners for `agent_conflict_resolution_started`, `agent_conflict_resolution_completed`, `agent_conflict_resolution_failed` events and maps them to rebase conflict state updates
Rebase button is disabled while conflict resolution is in progress
On `agent_conflict_resolution_failed` or `rebase_conflict { status: 'failed' }`: error message is displayed and rebase button re-enabled
On `rebase_completed` after conflict resolution: UI returns to normal state
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The SSE events `agent_conflict_resolution_started/completed/failed` already exist in the EventSource subscription list in `useSSE.tsx` (lines 183+). The `rebase_conflict` event with `status: 'resolving' | 'failed'` is already handled in `useSSE.tsx:122-130`. The main work is: (1) updating the mutation onSuccess to handle the new 202 response, (2) extending types with error field, (3) displaying the resolving/failed states in UI components using the existing `rebaseConflict` from `useLiveTask()`.
